exercises.question: Which description gives an evaluation rather than just a feature?
options: Sería funcional porque necesito espacio para trabajar. [It would be functional because I need space to work.]
La vivienda tiene dos habitaciones y un baño. [The home has two bedrooms and a bathroom.]
La vivienda está en una calle muy larga. [The home is on a very long street.]

exercises.sentence: Mi vivienda ideal __ funcional y acogedora.
exercises.english: My ideal home would be functional and welcoming.
The house I would choose would have a garden, although it would be more expensive.

sentences: La casa tendría un jardín. [The house would have a garden.]
Sería más cara que un piso. [It would be more expensive than a flat.]
Sin embargo, tendría más privacidad. [However, it would have more privacy.]

exercises.question: «Prefiero una vivienda funcional porque necesito espacio para trabajar.» Why does the speaker prefer a functional home?
options: Porque necesita espacio para trabajar. [Because they need space to work.]
Porque quiere pagar más alquiler. [Because they want to pay more rent.]
Porque no necesita privacidad. [Because they do not need privacy.]

exercises.sentence: El lugar sería acogedor y tendría bastante __ para convivir cómodamente.
exercises.english: The place would be welcoming and have enough privacy to live together comfortably.

exercises.question: Why did the narrator pay for the flat quickly?
options: Porque el piso parecía perfecto en las fotos. [Because the flat looked perfect in the photos.]
Porque el propietario le pidió más dinero. [Because the landlord asked him for more money.]
Porque sus vecinos le dijeron que no esperara. [Because his neighbours told him not to wait.]

exercises.question: What did two neighbours do on the rainy night?
options: Fueron a ayudarlo a limpiar la cocina. [They went to help him clean the kitchen.]
Llamaron a la policía desde su ventana. [They called the police from their window.]
Se quedaron en su casa sin hacer nada. [They stayed at home and did nothing.]

exercises.question: At the end, what does the narrator value more than the photos of the advert?
options: A sus vecinos. [His neighbours.]
Las ventanas viejas. [The old windows.]
El ruido de la calle. [The noise of the street.]

exercises.sentence: La casa que elegiría tendría un jardín, aunque sería más cara que un piso.
options: The house I would choose would have a garden, although it would be more expensive than a flat.
The house I chose had a garden because it was cheaper than a flat in the centre.
The house I will choose will not have a garden, but it will be much cheaper.

exercises.sentence: Prefiero una vivienda funcional porque necesito espacio para trabajar.
options: I prefer a functional home because I need space to work.
I preferred an expensive home because I needed a garden.
I prefer a large home although I do not work there.

exercises.sentence: Aunque no sería muy grande, tendría un entorno tranquilo y estaría bien comunicado.
exercises.english: Although it would not be very large, it would have a quiet setting and good transport links.

exercises.sentence: El lugar sería acogedor y tendría bastante privacidad para convivir cómodamente.
options: The place would be welcoming and have enough privacy to live together comfortably.
The place is large and has no privacy because the people live separately.
The place would be noisy and have no garden, so nobody could live there.
Sería funcional y acogedora, y tendría bastante privacidad para trabajar en casa. [It would be functional and welcoming, and it would have enough privacy to work at home.]
Sea funcional y acogedora, y tenga bastante privacidad para trabajar en casa. [It would be functional and welcoming, and it would have enough privacy to work at home.]
Fue funcional y acogedora, y tuvo bastante privacidad para trabajar en casa. [It would be functional and welcoming, and it would have enough privacy to work at home.]

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: ¿Qué es más importante para ti, el espacio o el entorno?

options: Prefiero un entorno tranquilo, aunque la vivienda no sea muy grande. [I prefer a quiet environment, although the home may not be very large.]
Prefiero un entorno tranquilo, aunque la vivienda no sean muy grandes. [I prefer a quiet environment, although the home may not be very large.]
Prefiero un entorno tranquilo, aunque la vivienda no ser muy grande. [I prefer a quiet environment, although the home may not be very large.]
Porque con privacidad puedo trabajar y descansar mejor. [Because with privacy I can work and rest better.]
Por eso con privacidad puedo trabajar y descansar mejor. [Because with privacy I can work and rest better.]
Aunque con privacidad puedo trabajar y descansar mejor. [Because with privacy I can work and rest better.]

template.prompt: Say that you would choose the home that is quieter and brighter than your current flat, because you need to rest well.
template.answer: Elegiría la vivienda que es más tranquila y luminosa que mi piso actual, porque necesito descansar bien.

template.prompt: Say that a suitable home would be functional and welcoming, with enough privacy to live together comfortably.
template.answer: Una vivienda adecuada sería funcional y acogedora, con bastante privacidad para convivir cómodamente.
